mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_learn_duration (user_id, video_id, valid_duration, watch_count, last_report_time, last_watch_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{videoId}, #{validSeconds}, 1, #{reportTime}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE valid_duration = valid_duration + IF(#{reportTime} > last_report_time, #{validSeconds}, 0), last_report_time = IF(#{reportTime} > last_report_time, #{reportTime}, last_report_time), last_watch_time = IF(#{reportTime} > last_report_time, NOW(), last_watch_time)
